notes: In older or poetic Russian, 'лето' can also mean 'year', which is why people say 'сколько вам лет?' (how many summers/years do you have?) when asking someone's age.

senses.definition: The warmest season of the year, coming between spring and autumn.

examples.text: Мы поедем на море этим летом.
examples.translation: We will go to the sea this summer.
examples.emotion: excited and happy about the upcoming holiday

senses.definition: A period of twelve months, a year (used mainly in counting age or in traditional phrases).

examples.emotion: matter-of-fact and calm when stating someone's age
